## Doctrine fits

[Where doctrine fits live and how they are maintained.] The full list is on the [Fits page](/fits).

## Fits on wiki pages

A doctrine fit is shown with the Fit component and its exact name, so it always matches what the waitlist checks. A fit that is not a doctrine fit can be pasted as EFT instead:

<Fit
  role="[Role]"
  caption="[What this fit is for.]"
  eft="[Ship name, Fit name]
Low slot module
Low slot module

Mid slot module
Mid slot module

High slot module
High slot module

Rig
Rig

Drone x5"
/>

See the [new pilot guide](/wiki/guides/newbro) if you are just starting out.
